b.40b3da886f:
<h>Invitatorium</h>
<r>Ant.</r> Regem ventúrum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.
<r>Ant.</r> Regem ventúrum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.
<c>V</c>eníte, exsultémus Dómino, iubilémus Deo, salutári nostro: præoccupémus fáciem eius in confessióne, et in psalmis iubilémus ei.
<r>Ant.</r> Regem ventúrum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.
<c>Q</c>uóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos, quóniam non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: quia in manu eius sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitúdines móntium ipse cónspicit.
<r>Ant.</r> Veníte, adorémus.
<c>Q</c>uóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius <n>(genuflectitur)</n> veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.
<r>Ant.</r> Regem ventúrum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.
<c>H</c>ódie, si vocem eius audiéritis, nolíte obduráre corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatióne secúndum diem tentatiónis in desérto: ubi tentavérunt me patres vestri, probavérunt et vidérunt ópera mea.
<r>Ant.</r> Veníte, adorémus.
<c>Q</c>uadragínta annis próximus fui generatióni huic, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde, ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas: quibus iurávi in ira mea: Si introíbunt in réquiem meam.
<r>Ant.</r> Regem ventúrum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.
<r>℣.</r> Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
<r>℟.</r> Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
<r>Ant.</r> Veníte, adorémus.
<r>Ant.</r> Regem ventúrum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.
b.869c7a0f72:
<h>Invitatory</h>
<r>Ant.</r> The Lord, the King who is to come * O come, let us adore Him.
<r>Ant.</r> The Lord, the King who is to come * O come, let us adore Him.
<c>C</c>ome let us praise the Lord with joy: let us joyfully sing to God our saviour. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.
<r>Ant.</r> The Lord, the King who is to come * O come, let us adore Him.
<c>F</c>or the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods. For the Lord will not cast off his people: for in his hand are all the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his.
<r>Ant.</r> O come, let us adore Him.
<c>F</c>or the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. <n>(genuflect)</n> Come let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us: For he is the Lord our God: and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.
<r>Ant.</r> The Lord, the King who is to come * O come, let us adore Him.
<c>T</c>oday if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.
<r>Ant.</r> O come, let us adore Him.
<c>F</c>orty years long was I offended with that generation, and I said: These always err in heart. And these men have not known my ways: so I swore in my wrath that they shall not enter into my rest.
<r>Ant.</r> The Lord, the King who is to come * O come, let us adore Him.
<r>℣.</r> Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.
<r>℟.</r> As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
<r>Ant.</r> O come, let us adore Him.

<h>Lectio 1</h>
De Isaía Prophéta
<r>Isa 3:1-3</r>
<n>1</n> Ecce enim Dominátor Dóminus exercítuum áuferet a Ierúsalem et a Iuda válidum et fortem, omne robur panis, et omne robur aquæ:
<n>2</n> Fortem, et virum bellatórem, Iúdicem, et prophétam, et aríolum, et senem:
<n>3</n> Príncipem super quinquagínta, et honorábilem vultu, et consiliárium, et sapiéntem de architéctis, et prudéntem elóquii mýstici.
<h>H</h>æc dicit Dóminus Deus: Convertímini ad me, et salvi éritis.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.

<r>℟.</r> Ave, María, grátia plena, Dóminus tecum:
* Spíritus Sanctus supervéniet in te, et virtus Altíssimi obumbrábit tibi: quod enim ex te nascétur Sanctum, vocábitur Fílius Dei.
<r>℣.</r> Quómodo fiet istud, quóniam virum non cognósco? Et respóndens Angelus, dixit ei.
<r>℟.</r> Spíritus Sanctus supervéniet in te, et virtus Altíssimi obumbrábit tibi: quod enim ex te nascétur Sanctum, vocábitur Fílius Dei.

<h>Reading 1</h>

<r>Isa 3:1-3</r>
<n>1</n> For behold, the sovereign the Lord of hosts shall take away from Jerusalem, and from Juda the valiant and the strong, the whole strength of bread, and the whole strength of water.
<n>2</n> The strong man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the cunning man, and the ancient.
<n>3</n> The captain over fifty, and the honourable in countenance, and the counsellor, and the architect, and the skilful in eloquent speech.
<h>H</h>æc dicit Dóminus Deus: Convertímini ad me, et salvi éritis.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.

<r>℟.</r> Hail, Mary, full of grace; the Lord is with thee;
* The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee; therefore, also that Holy Thing Which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
<r>℣.</r> How shall this be, seeing I know not a man? And the Angel answered and said unto her,
<r>℟.</r> The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee; therefore, also that Holy Thing Which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.

<h>Martyrologium</h>
<c>Q</c>uarto Nonas Decémbris Luna vicésima secúnda. Anno Dómini 2026
<h>R</h>omæ pássio sanctæ Bibiánæ, Vírginis et Mártyris, quæ, sub Iuliáno Imperatóre sacrílego, ob Christum támdiu plumbátis cæsa est, donec rédderet spíritum.
<h>A</h>pud Forum Cornélii, in Æmília, natális sancti Petri, Epíscopi Ravennátis, Confessóris et Ecclésiæ Doctóris, cognoménto Chrysólogi, doctrína et sanctitáte célebris. Ipsíus tamen festum prídie Nonas huius mensis recólitur.
<h>I</h>n Sanciáno, Sinárum ínsula, item natális sancti Francísci Xavérii, Sacerdótis e Societáte Iesu et Confessóris, Indiárum Apóstoli, géntium conversióne, donis et miráculis clari; qui plenus méritis et labóribus obdormívit in Dómino. Ipsum beátum virum Pius Décimus, Póntifex Máximus, cæléstem sodalitáti et óperi Propagándæ Fídei Protectórem elégit atque constítuit; Pius vero Papa Undécimus peculiárem ómnibus Missiónibus Patrónum dedit et confirmávit. Eius autem festívitas, iussu Alexándri Papæ Séptimi, sequénti die celebrátur.
<h>R</h>omæ sanctórum Mártyrum Eusébii Presbýteri, Marcélli Diáconi, Hippólyti, Máximi, Adriæ, Paulínæ, Neónis, Maríæ, Martánæ et Auréliæ; qui omnes in persecutióne Valeriáni, sub Secundiáno Iúdice, martýrium complevérunt.
<h>I</h>tem Romæ sancti Pontiáni Mártyris, cum áliis quátuor.
<h>I</h>n Africa natális sanctórum Mártyrum Sevéri, Secúri, Ianuárii et Victoríni; qui ibídem martýrio coronáti sunt.
<h>A</h>quiléiæ sancti Chromátii, Epíscopi et Confessóris.
<h>V</h>erónæ sancti Lupi, Epíscopi et Confessóris.
<h>E</h>déssæ, in Sýria, sancti Nonni Epíscopi, cuius précibus Pelágia pǽnitens ad Christum convérsa est.
<h>T</h>róade, in Phrýgia, sancti Silváni Epíscopi, miráculis clari.
<h>B</h>ríxiæ sancti Evásii Epíscopi.
<r>℣.</r> Et álibi aliórum plurimórum sanctórum Mártyrum et Confessórum, atque sanctárum Vírginum.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.
b.19d8841ca2:
<h>Martyrology</h>
<c>D</c>ecember 2nd 2026, the 22nd day of the Moon, were born into the better life:
<h>A</h>t Rome, (about the year 363,) the holy Virgin and martyr Bibiana, who under, the profane Emperor Julian was for Christ's sake flogged to death with scourges loaded with lead.
<h>A</h>t Imola, (in the year 450,) holy Peter, Bishop of Ravenna, styled Chrysologus, (or him of the golden words,) famous for his teaching and holiness, whose feast we keep upon the 4th day of this present month.
<h>I</h>n the island of San-Chan, in the Canton River, in China, holy Francis Xavier, Priest of the Society of Jesus and Confessor, Apostle of the Indies, illustrious for the conversion of the Gentiles, for gifts and miracles, who fell asleep in the Lord, (in the year 1552,) full of good works and labours. Pope Pius X chose and appointed this blessed man the heavenly Protector of the Society and Work of the Propagation of the Faith, and Pope Pius XI gave and confirmed him as the special Patron of all Missions. His feast, however, is kept upon the morrow by order of Pope Alexander VII.
<h>A</h>t Rome, the holy martyrs the Priest Eusebius, the Deacon Marcellus, Hippolytus, Maximus, Adria, Paulina, Neo, Mary, Martana, and Aurelia, who suffered martyrdom under the judge Secundian, in the persecution under the Emperor Valerian, (in the year 256.)
<h>L</h>ikewise at Rome, (at the end of the 2nd century,) the holy martyr Pontian and four others.
<h>I</h>n Africa, the holy martyrs Severus, Securus, Januarius, and Victorinus, who were there crowned with martyrdom, (about the year of Christ 300.)
<h>A</h>t Aquileia, (about the year 409,) the holy Confessor Chromatius, Bishop (of that see.)
<h>A</h>t Verona, (in the sixth century,) the holy Confessor Lupus, Bishop (of that see.)
<h>A</h>t Edessa, (about the year 468,) holy Nonnus, Bishop (first of that see, and afterwards of Heliopolis in Syria,) through whose prayers Pelagia the penitent was converted to Christ.
<h>A</h>t Troas, in Phrygia, holy Bishop Silvanus, famous for miracles.
<h>A</h>t Brescia, holy Bishop Evasius.
<r>℣.</r> And elsewhere many other holy martyrs, confessors, and holy virgins.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.
